collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
Account (via Clerk): name and email.
Persona data: settings, rules, and the question–answer examples you add (each marked private or public).
Conversations: messages visitors send and the AI answers, with an anonymous visitor id (cookie).
Usage events: persona created, published, link opened, message sent — to measure the product.

providers.title: Third-party model providers
providers.body: To generate answers, our servers send your message, the persona settings, and relevant examples to external language-model providers (such as Anthropic and OpenAI). Your browser never contacts providers directly. Providers may retain data temporarily under their own policies. Do not put passwords, financial details, or confidential information in messages or examples.

examples.title: Private and public examples
examples.body:
Examples marked "private" are only used when you test your own persona and are never included in prompts when visitors chat. Public examples may be shown on the persona page and used to answer visitors.
Do not upload other people's messages without consent (Thailand PDPA).

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.body: Visitors can chat without an account. We set a visitor-id cookie for rate limiting and unique-visitor counts. By default the creator sees only aggregate stats, not your messages. If a creator enables reading conversations, the persona page says so before you chat.

retention.title: Retention and security
retention.body: Data is stored on servers in the Singapore region. Conversations are kept to continue chats and improve the product. You can delete your personas and examples from the studio at any time.

rights.title: Your rights and contact
rights.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. Contact the operator through the channel listed on the service's home page.

service.title: The service
service.body: Persona Platform lets you create an AI persona that imitates your answering style, test it, and share a link so others can chat with it. The service is in an early phase and may change or be discontinued.

personas.title: Personas of real people
personas.body: You may publish an "AI version of" only yourself. Do not create personas that impersonate other people (celebrities, coworkers, anyone) using their name or image.

content.title: Your content
content.body: You own the examples and settings you add and grant us a license to use them to run the service (building style cards, answering visitors). You must have the rights to what you upload, and must not include passwords, confidential company data, or other people's messages.

ai.title: AI limitations
ai.body: Answers are generated by language models and can be wrong. Every persona carries an "AI version of" label and does not know the creator's personal life. Do not use the service to produce illegal, harassing, or harmful content. Content moderation and a report button are in place.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The service is provided "as is". We do not guarantee the accuracy of answers and are not liable for damages arising from use, to the extent permitted by law.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms; the date above shows the latest version. Continued use means you accept the updated terms.

preview.label: Chat preview
preview.name: Mew
preview.question: React or Vue — which is better for a beginner?
preview.answer:
If you are just starting, think of it like this:
• Vue = a set menu, everything included, quick to start
• React = an empty kitchen, lots of freedom, more choices to make
Summary: want fast results, pick Vue; want more job options, pick React
